style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D), exactly matching the skill icons in the reference sheet: a single square skill icon, a dark navy rounded-square badge with a thin bright outline, and one glowing item centred inside it, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights. Draw exactly one icon, centred, filling most of the frame.

frames.name: icon_spore_cloud
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a soft puffball cloud of yellow-green spores drifting out of a small mushroom cap, with a few glowing motes.

frames.name: icon_hardened_shell
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a domed, spotted mushroom-cap shield in red and cream with a sturdy rim, glowing faintly.

frames.name: icon_binding_web
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a round silver spider web patch with a glowing bound thread pinning a small dark shape at its centre.

frames.name: icon_miasma
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a swirling green poison cloud spreading outward in a cone, with a few toxic bubbles.

frames.name: icon_venom_bolt
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a single glowing green venom bolt streaking diagonally, with a droplet-shaped tip and a fading trail.

frames.name: icon_healing_spores
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a soft pink and green cloud of spores with a small glowing plus sign floating in it.

frames.name: icon_puffball
frames.prompt: A skill icon of a round spotted puffball pod bursting open into a wide cloud of yellow-green spores.
